headline: Uber has started testing self-driving cars in Manchester, with a safety driver on board and no passengers yet.
score_reason: Fresh and accurately headlined, but it is an early mapping trial with no passenger service applied for.
importance_line: Drivers and city officials in Greater Manchester face the prospect of robotaxis, but only mapping with a safety driver has begun and no passenger licence has been sought.
summary: The Guardian reports that Uber has begun testing self-driving cars in Manchester using technology from its partners Pony and Verne, as a first step towards robotaxis in UK cities. For now the cars only map the streets with a safety driver and no passengers, no application for a passenger service has been made, and driver unions say thousands of jobs would be at risk.
